inherited_or_unverified_limits: At the supported 360px width, the unchanged project pane occupies almost the whole editor area and the task/console split clips text. Copy still returns the same 1425-byte displayed payload as restored-wide output. This is not complete Android Studio narrow layout fidelity.

Return does not activate the generic toolbar tab; focused Sync and selected Sync are distinct. Space activation is the actual successful path, and Return/focus-only screenshots receive no activation credit.
This change adds console transport separation, not full Android Studio output error parsers, hyperlinks/quick fixes, complete event-tree parity, logical Android project view or full IDE completion.
Real SDK runs use AGP 9.4.0/Gradle 9.6.1/JDK 21 in a small fixture. They are supplementary actual native evidence, not execution of pinned upstream Android Studio test runners.
No device/emulator launch credit; SDK emulator binary is absent. Software Vulkan screenshots do not establish hardware GPU performance, large-project responsiveness or startup benchmarks.

No native cancellation-state screenshot was supplied. Cancellation/timeout behavior has passing current supplemental tests, but only loading, settled success, empty tab, actual failure and focus/selection states receive screenshot credit.

The current full app consumed the actual model and selected :app/demoDebug. Complete raw sidecar equality is retained, but no standalone current Rust native model probe was compiled; do not claim such a probe.
